court.name: High Court of Judicature at Madras

summary: In May 2021, one person was accused of the rape of a minor in Tiruvannamalai, Tamil Nadu. The charges also include wrongful restraint and attempting the offence. The accused was convicted and sentenced to 5 years in prison. An appeal against the verdict has been filed. Identifying details are withheld by law (POCSO s.23).
title: Rape of a minor — Tiruvannamalai (2021) — convicted, 5 years
